explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly validates GPT-4o's conversation termination judgments against human assessments on a subset, reporting 76% accuracy

prompts.notes: Full prompts provided in Appendix D.2 for conversation termination judgment and in Appendix D.3 for plot-progression moment classification

guidelines.notes: Comprehensive guidelines provided in Appendix C for plot turning point annotation using five narrative theory categories

sample_size.notes: Validation conducted on a sampled subset of GPT-4o annotated dialogues, exact sample size not specified

quantitative_scores.notes: Human verification of GPT-4o's termination judgments

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4o achieves 76% accuracy in conversation termination judgment when validated against human assessments.

criteria_mapping.notes: Human evaluators primarily annotated plot turning points without directly judging conversation termination, while GPT-4o was used for conversation termination judgment with human validation on a subset
